name: 30339 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30339 (Atlanta) has 363 nonprofit organizations. 134 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 110 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30339 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30339 (Atlanta) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 110 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
